verdict.rationale: Sierra's Agent SDK lets teams write customer journeys as code and track changes within existing development workflows, which covers versioning. Release governance adds merge approval workflows for human review, split-traffic gradual rollouts, and Agent Checks and Simulations to catch regressions. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of rollback or revert to a prior agent version, versioning or review for no-code Agent Studio/Ghostwriter changes, and independent hands-on corroboration (the 'track changes' claim comes from a vendor-hosted customer quote).
